report: Button (a bug icon) in the header, and the item in the account menu, that opens the dialog to report an issue to the team's tracker.
file-run: Button under a socio's failed run (a turn that failed) that files an issue about it.
file-run-label: Accessible name of that button; {{run}} is the run's chat title or id.
notice.done: Toast title: a capability a socio (AI agent) asked for is now built; {{capability}} names it, in the socio's words.
notice.wont-fix: Toast title: a capability a socio asked for won't be built.
notice.asked-by: Under the toast's title: {{key}} is the issue's key (CB-12), {{dots}} the socios that asked.
notice.resolution: Adds the issue's resolution, as written on the tracker, to the line above ({{text}}).
notice.view: Button in the toast that opens the issue.
widget.title: Home page card for the team's issue tracker.
widget.open: The card's number: how many issues are open.
widget.triage: Under it: how many wait in triage, the tracker's first status, to be sorted.
filings.title: Heading of the panel, on a socio's page, of what it filed on the issue board for you.
filings.item: One filed issue: {{key}} is its key (CB-12), {{title}} its title.
